40분 8차시 수업 운영과 학생 활동지 활용: Running eight 40-minute lessons and using the student worksheets
초등 5~6학년을 기준으로, 학생이 원하는 앱을 설명하고 결과를 예상하며: Designed for grades 5–6: students describe the app they want, predict the result, then check and fix it themselves. Teachers look beyond the on-screen completion marks to predictions, observations, reasons for fixes, and explanations.
기본 연습실은 준비된 코드와 규칙을 바꾸는 활동입니다. 요청문을 자유롭게: The basic practice room is about changing prepared code and rules. Writing a free-form request does not generate or run arbitrary code. Real AI building happens in Lesson 6, done by a teacher or adult in an external tool.
각 차시는 도입 5분·전개 30분·정리 5분입니다. 기기 1대당 2명을: Each lesson is Opening 5 min · Activity 30 min · Wrap-up 5 min. Default is 2 students per device, but each student can fill in their own worksheet. For grades 3–4, add read-alouds, choice cards, and oral explanations, and reduce writing.
자료 기준 2026년 10월 25일 배포 화면. 학생 활동지는 앞뒤 2: Based on the screens released October 25, 2026. There are 8 student worksheets, each 2 pages (front/back). The app records per work, so bundle paper worksheets with a representative work to build process records.
□ Open the web app on a school device and confirm buttons, input, and on-device saving work.
□ Select Kids mode and review the per-lesson mission guides in Teacher resources.
□ 퀴즈 3의 중복 점수와 퀴즈 4의 초기화 오류를 교사가 먼저 재현합니: □ Reproduce the duplicate-score bug in Quiz 3 and the reset bug in Quiz 4 yourself first.
□ 기기 1대당 2명과 활동지 1인 1부를 준비하고 운전자·관찰자를 정합: □ Prepare 2 students per device and one worksheet each; assign driver and observer.
□ 미션 주소만 학급에 제공합니다. 작품 URL이 다른 기기의 작품을 열: □ Give the class only the mission URL. A work URL does not open a work from another device.
□ 6차시 외부 AI 도구·교사용 실행 환경·사전 예제·화면 자료를 준비: □ For Lesson 6, prepare the external AI tool, a teacher run environment, a prepared example, and screen printouts.
학생에게 먼저 알려 줄 약속: Agreements to share with students first
실명·이메일·연락처·사진을 앱이나 AI 요청에 넣지 않습니다. 모둠 번호: Never put real names, emails, contact info, or photos into the app or an AI request. Use group numbers or nicknames. Records stay on the current device and browser and do not move to other devices automatically.
Predict first, then press. Compare expected and actual rather than chasing right answers. Passing an auto check does not mean the student saw it themselves. Use a friend's work with permission and give feedback based on observed facts.
In Teacher resources, expand the lesson and use Copy student mission URL. If copying is blocked, follow the on-screen select-and-copy instructions. When printing worksheets, choose the lesson's two pages and print one page per side.
시간이 부족하면 종이에 예상·실제·이유를 먼저 남기고 다음 시간에 이어: If time runs short, record prediction, actual result, and reason on paper first and continue next time. Do not make students enter the same long text in both the app and on paper.
첫 작품 만들기 또는 미션 공작대에서 시작합니다. 예시로 채워진 사용자·: Start from Make your first work or the Mission bench. Edit the sample user, problem, features, and done condition, then press Build with this promise.
내가 처음 쓴 요청문에 한 문장을 적고 만들기 약속으로 요청문 정리를 누: Write one sentence in My first request and press Tidy request from the promise. Both the original and the tidied request are kept. Changing the request alone does not change the run rules, so check the settings too.
먼저 예상 적기를 눌러 실행 전 나의 예상을 씁니다. 설정과 규칙을 확인: Press Write prediction first and record your prediction before running. Check the settings and rules, then use the small app yourself. If you change the prediction, run again so the record matches that prediction.
현재 설정 자동 검사를 누르면 자동 결과와 직접 확인 카드가 함께 준비됩: Press Auto-check current settings to get the auto result and a hands-on check card. Write the actual result and choose a check status. After fixing a setting, re-check the same way and write what you want to change and why.
작동 원리와 배운 점, 도움받은 내용을 적습니다. 이 과정 버전으로 저장: Write how it works, what you learned, and what help you received. Use Save as process version or Save in the versions panel. Collect and print records from the process portfolio.
이동할 때 달라지는 것: What changes when you move around
퀴즈 점수·이야기 장면은 같은 작품의 단계 이동 중 유지됩니다. 설정을: Quiz scores and story scenes persist while moving between steps of the same work. Changing settings, reopening a work, or restoring a version resets the run screen. A timer stops when you change screens or steps and is stopped when reopened.
그대로인 직접 관찰을 지우고 다시 쓰게 하지 않습니다. 재검사는 현재 설: Do not make students erase unchanged hands-on observations and rewrite them. Re-checking refreshes the auto result for the current settings and keeps checks and saved versions from earlier settings.
학습 목표 생활 속 작은 문제를 고르고, 퀴즈 안내 한 가지를 바꾸어: Goal  Pick a small everyday problem, change one quiz message, and explain why.
연결 미션 선택이 정답을 만났을 때: Linked mission  When a choice meets the answer
준비와 시작 어린이 모드와 퀴즈 1을 연다. 첫 문제의 정답은 햇빛과: Setup  Open Kids mode and Quiz 1. The first question's answer is Sunlight and water. Each pair needs 1 device and the 2-page Lesson 1 worksheet.
교사 발문 “정답을 골랐다는 것을 친구가 어떻게 알 수 있을까요?” “: Guiding questions  “How can a friend tell they chose the right answer?” “What wording would tell them what to do next when they're wrong?”
확인할 학습 증거 예상 한 문장, 직접 본 안내·점수, 바꾸기 전후 문: Evidence to check  One-sentence prediction, the message and score they saw, the before/after sentences, and the reason for the change. Not every step needs to be green in the first lesson.
교사가 확인할 예시 정상 시작 작품은 정답 1점, 오답 0점이다. 오답: Teacher reference  A normal starting work gives 1 point for correct, 0 for wrong. To check wrong answers, restart and pick a different answer. Do not fill in the student's actual-observation box for them.
수준별 도움 글쓰기가 어려우면 “나는 ___를 위한 퀴즈를 만들어요”: Differentiation  If writing is hard, give the frame “I'm making a quiz for ___” and have the partner read aloud. Fast students change one more message.
기기 문제 대안 화면 카드에서 답을 고르고 종이 점수 토큰으로 실행한다: No-device fallback  Pick answers from screen cards and run with paper score tokens. Results not confirmed in the real app stay Not checked yet.
정리와 저장 1차시 안내 수정이라는 이름으로 버전을 남긴다. 시간 부족: Wrap-up and save  Save a version named Lesson 1 message fix. If short on time, keep prediction, actual, and reason on paper first.
학습 목표 사용자·기능·예외 상황·완료 조건을 포함하도록 제작 요청을: Goal  Make the build request specific, including user, features, edge cases, and done condition.
준비와 시작 내 작품 선반에서 1차시 작품을 다시 연다. 없으면 퀴즈: Setup  Reopen the Lesson 1 work from My works. If none, start Quiz 1. Keep the original and compare the tidied request before and after.
교사 발문 “재미있게 대신 무엇이 나오면 완성이라고 할 수 있을까요?”: Guiding questions  “Instead of ‘fun’, what has to appear for it to count as done?” “Did you say what happens when the same answer is pressed several times?”
확인할 학습 증거 검사 가능한 조건을 추가했는지 살핀다. 문장이 길어졌: Evidence to check  Look for added conditions that can be checked. A longer sentence alone is not a higher level.
교사가 확인할 예시 “정답을 고르면 1점, 오답은 0점이며 같은 문제는: Teacher reference  “Correct = 1 point, wrong = 0, and each question is scored only once” is easy to check because action and result are linked. Changing the request alone does not change the run rules.
수준별 도움 여섯 질문 중 두 가지부터 말로 답하게 한다. 확장 활동은: Differentiation  Start by answering two of the six questions aloud. Extension: add one more condition for empty input or restart.
No-device fallback  Write the request on paper before editing; the partner acts as the runner. Find vague parts by asking follow-up questions.
정리와 저장 먼저 요청 수정 전 버전을 저장한다. 수정 후에는 요청 구: Wrap-up and save  First save a Before request edit version. After editing, save a new version named Request detail to keep the original for comparison.
학습 목표 선택과 도착 장면의 관계를 예상하고, 두 길을 직접 확인하여: Goal  Predict how a choice links to the destination scene, then check both paths and explain.
연결 미션 내 선택이 길을 만들어요: Linked mission  My choice makes the path
준비와 시작 이야기 1을 연다. 나무 쪽과 햇빛 쪽 선택이 서로 다른: Setup  Open Story 1. Use the normal work where the tree and sunlight choices lead to different endings.
교사 발문 “선택지의 글만 바꾸면 도착 장면도 바뀔까요?” “결말이 있: Guiding questions  “If we only change the choice text, does the destination change too?” “If an ending exists but no path leads there, can we reach it?”
확인할 학습 증거 선택 문장과 연결 설정을 구별하고, 필요한 두 결말을: Evidence to check  Can they tell choice text from link settings, and did they check both required endings?
교사가 확인할 예시 기본 연결은 커다란 나무 쪽으로 → 나무 도서관,: Teacher reference  Default links: Toward the big tree → Tree Library; Toward the sunlight → Sunny Garden. Back to start resets the opening scene and the path taken.
수준별 도움 장면 카드 세 장을 놓고 손가락으로 길을 짚게 한다. 빠른: Differentiation  Lay out three scene cards and trace the path with a finger. Fast students add a new ending and link a choice to it.
기기 문제 대안 종이 장면 카드와 화살표로 이동한다. 실제 앱의 연결을: No-device fallback  Move with paper scene cards and arrows. If the real app's links were not checked, mark it as a paper dry run.
정리와 저장 길 안내 수정 전후 버전을 남긴다. 친구가 고른 길과 실제: Wrap-up and save  Save versions before and after the path fix. Write the path a friend chose and the actual destination on the worksheet.
학습 목표 점수·문제 번호·답한 상태를 찾아 다시 시작 전후를 비교하고: Goal  Find score, question number, and answered state; compare before/after restart; fix the reset rule.
Setup  Quiz 4 contains a practice rule with score reset turned off. Keep 2 questions, 1 point each, and build up a score first.
교사 발문 “문제는 처음인데 점수가 남아 있으면 어떤 일이 생길까요?”: Guiding questions  “What happens if we're on question 1 but the score is still there?” “If we clear only the score, what about Already answered?”
확인할 학습 증거 입력과 기억 값을 구별하고, 세 상태를 근거로 초기화: Evidence to check  Do they separate input from remembered values, and explain the reset using all three states?
교사가 확인할 예시 두 문제를 모두 맞히면 2점·2번·이미 답함 예이다: Teacher reference  Getting both right gives 2 points · No. 2 · Already answered: Yes. Restarting with the starting rule gives 2 points · No. 1 · No. With score reset on, restart gives 0 points · No. 1 · No.
수준별 도움 세 값의 이름을 미리 적은 종이 점수판을 준다. 빠른 학생: Differentiation  Give a paper scoreboard with the three value names pre-written. Fast students also compare the timer's remaining time and running state.
기기 문제 대안 점수 토큰·문제 번호 카드·응답 여부 카드를 세 사람이: No-device fallback  Three students hold the score tokens, question-number card, and answered card and act out the reset.
정리와 저장 초기화 수정 전후의 검사와 버전을 남긴다. 작품을 다시 열: Wrap-up and save  Save checks and versions before and after the reset fix. Also confirm that reopening a work resets the run state.
학습 목표 중복 점수를 같은 행동으로 재현하고, 한 가지 규칙을 고친: Goal  Reproduce the duplicate score with the same action, fix one rule, re-check, and explain why.
연결 미션 어라 점수가 또 올라가요: Linked mission  Huh? The score keeps going up!
준비와 시작 퀴즈 3의 학습용 오류 작품을 연다. 정상 규칙의 새 작품: Setup  Open the Quiz 3 practice-bug work. New work with normal rules has no bug, so use Start this mission.
교사 발문 “버튼을 몇 번 눌렀는지와 맞힌 문제 수는 같은가요?” “고: Guiding questions  “Is the number of presses the same as the number of correct answers?” “What action must you repeat before saying it's fixed?”
확인할 학습 증거 설정 한 가지를 바꾸고 같은 조건으로 재검사한 기록을: Evidence to check  A record of changing one setting and re-checking under the same conditions. Separate auto-check passes from hands-on observation.
교사가 확인할 예시 문제당 1점일 때 학습용 규칙은 첫 정답 세 번에: Teacher reference  At 1 point per question, the practice rule gives 3 points for three presses on the first correct answer. Set to once per question, the same action gives 1 point. The key explanation: checking the Already answered state blocks duplicate scoring.
수준별 도움 운전자와 점수 관찰자를 정한다. “상황은 ___, 기대는: Differentiation  Assign a driver and a score observer. Provide the frame “Situation ___, expected ___, actual ___.” Extension: change points per question and set a new expected value.
기기 문제 대안 시도할 때마다 토큰을 주는 규칙과 한 문제에 한 번 주: No-device fallback  Compare a rule that gives a token every try with one that gives a token once per question. Clearly mark when the app was not run.
정리와 저장 중복 점수 수정 전과 중복 점수 수정 후 버전을 각각 남긴: Wrap-up and save  Save separate versions: Before duplicate-score fix and After duplicate-score fix. Confirm the real save status before file backup.
학습 목표 학생이 요청·예상·검사를 정하고 교사가 외부 AI로 제작한: Goal  Students set the request, prediction, and checks; observe what the teacher builds with external AI; write a fix request.
준비와 시작 교사가 학교에서 사용할 수 있는 외부 AI 도구와 별도 실: Setup  The teacher prepares an external AI tool approved for school use and a separate run environment. Students do not sign up for accounts. Also prepare a prepared example and printed screens.
교사 발문 “복사했다는 사실과 실행 결과를 봤다는 사실은 어떻게 다를까: Guiding questions  “How is ‘I copied it’ different from ‘I saw it run’?” “What should stay as is, and what exactly should change?”
확인할 학습 증거 도구명·예상·검사·실제 관찰의 출처를 확인한다. 생성: Evidence to check  Tool name, prediction, checks, and the source of actual observations. Do not grade generation success or speed as student achievement.
교사가 확인할 예시 기본 연습실은 요청문을 임의 코드로 실행하지 않는다: Teacher reference  The basic practice room does not run requests as arbitrary code. In the Real AI build record, write tool, prediction, criteria, observation, and verdict separately. This app does not auto-check external AI code.
수준별 도움 학생은 말이나 문장 틀로 요청을 만들고 교사는 조작을 맡는: Differentiation  Students form the request orally or with sentence frames; the teacher operates the tool. Include score-once, result, and restart conditions in the request.
기기 문제 대안 10분 안에 생성이 끝나지 않으면 사전 예제로 같은 검: No-device fallback  If generation is not done within 10 min, run the same checks on the prepared example. Mark New generation, Prepared example, or Not run; never record an example of unclear AI origin as a real AI completion.
정리와 저장 작품의 실제 AI 제작 기록과 활동지 6차시를 남긴다. 복: Wrap-up and save  Keep the work's Real AI build record and the Lesson 6 worksheet. If you only copied, leave the actual result as Not checked yet.
학습 목표 친구의 관찰 의견을 듣고 안내나 연결을 한 가지 개선한 뒤: Goal  Listen to a friend's observations, improve one message or link, and re-check with the same action.
연결 미션 친구의 한마디로 더 좋은 이야기: Linked mission  A better story from a friend's words
준비와 시작 이야기 4 또는 3차시의 이야기 작품을 연다. 한 기기를: Setup  Open Story 4 or the Lesson 3 story work. Two students share one device and each writes observed facts on their own worksheet.
교사 발문 “친구가 멈칫한 순간에 무엇이 보였나요?” “모든 의견을 그: Guiding questions  “What did you see at the moment your friend hesitated?” “Should every opinion be applied as is? How do you decide?”
확인할 학습 증거 의견과 자동 검사 결과를 구분하고, 관찰 사실을 수정: Evidence to check  Do they separate opinions from auto-check results and use observed facts as the basis for the fix?
교사가 확인할 예시 “재미없다”보다 “햇빛 쪽을 눌렀는데 예상한 정원: Teacher reference  “I pressed the sunlight side but couldn't find the garden title I expected” helps more than “It's boring.” Keep valid scene links even when changing choices or descriptions.
수준별 도움 말하기 틀 “나는 ___를 눌렀고 ___가 보였어. ___: Differentiation  Use the speaking frame “I pressed ___ and saw ___. ___ confused me.” Fast pairs get one more check from another user.
기기 문제 대안 장면·선택 카드로 사용 상황을 재현한다. 기기가 한 대: No-device fallback  Recreate the use case with scene and choice cards. With only one device, rotate driver, observer, and presenter roles.
정리와 저장 친구 의견 전과 안내 수정 후 버전을 남긴다. 작품 제목과: Wrap-up and save  Save versions Before friend feedback and After message fix. Write the work title and the feedback applied on the worksheet.
8차시 새 문제에 적용하기: Lesson 8 Applying to a new problem
학습 목표 새 사용자와 조건에 맞게 타이머를 만들고 검사 근거와 원리를: Goal  Build a timer for a new user and conditions, explain the check evidence and principles, and bundle the process records.
연결 미션 몇 번이고 다시 시작: Linked mission  Start again, as many times as you like
준비와 시작 타이머 4를 연다. 새 과제는 운동 연습 20초 뒤 휴식: Setup  Open Timer 4. New task: a workout tool that announces a rest after 20 seconds and supports pause, resume, and reset. Do not submit the existing 30-second example as is.
교사 발문 “30초를 20초로 바꿀 때 검사 기대값도 어떻게 달라지나요: Guiding questions  “When 30 s becomes 20 s, how do the expected check values change?” “Why are pause and reset different?”
확인할 학습 증거 새 조건에 완료 기준을 조정하고, 실제 결과를 근거로: Evidence to check  Did they adjust the done criteria for the new conditions and explain using actual results? Review the Lesson 8 paper record with the representative work.
교사가 확인할 예시 20초 설정에서 초기화는 20초·정지, 일시정지는: Teacher reference  At 20 s: reset gives 20 s · stopped, pause keeps the remaining time, resume continues from that point. The end message at 0 s appears once per run and never goes negative.
수준별 도움 사용자·시간·끝 안내 세 조건 카드를 준다. 확장은 퀴즈나: Differentiation  Give three condition cards: user, time, end message. Extension: explain how to carry the same check method to a quiz or story.
No-device fallback  Dry-run on paper by swapping time and running-state cards. Anything not checked in the real app stays Not checked yet.
정리와 저장 새 과제 완성 버전과 JSON을 보관한다. 포트폴리오는 작: Wrap-up and save  Keep the completed new-task version and the JSON. The portfolio is per work, so bundle the Lesson 8 worksheet with the printed representative work to complete the process records.
Autosave keeps the current edits; look for Saved on device. Before and after a meaningful change, expand the Compare and restore versions panel, enter a name, and press Save current edit as version.
버전에는 설정·요청·예상·검사·이유가 함께 담깁니다. 이전 버전을 복원할: A version holds settings, request, prediction, checks, and reasons together. When restoring an older version, the pre-restore edit is also kept. Restoring settings does not keep a running timer going.
1. Press File backup in the workspace or List backup in My works.
2. Check the browser's download list for the new JSON file.
3. 허용된 방법으로 파일을 새 기기에 옮기고 내 작품 선반의 파일 가져: 3. Move the file to the new device by an approved method and choose Import file in My works.
4. Open the imported copy and check the title, settings, prediction, and check records.
파일은 스키마 버전 1의 JSON 2MB 이하입니다. 큰 목록은 여러 파: Files are schema version 1 JSON, up to 2 MB. Large lists are split into several files. A work holds up to 30 versions, 600 KB total. If you hit question, scene, check, or character limits, read the notice, back up, then tidy.
저장 실패 시 편집 내용이 보이는 동안 파일 백업부터 합니다. 저장 공간: If a save fails, do a file backup first while the edits are still visible. Check storage space and browser permissions, then use Retry save. Do not close the window or clear data before confirming Saved.
다음 사용자 시작은 최근 작품 연결을 비우고 이전 목록을 접어 둘 뿐,: Start next user only clears the recent-work link and collapses the previous list; it is not privacy protection or full deletion. The next user can still open shared records explicitly. Deleting a work, selected checks, or the whole app: confirm the scope and back up first.
학급 진도 자동 수합이나 실시간 공동 편집은 없습니다. 교사는 활동지·직: There is no automatic class progress collection or real-time co-editing. Teachers check via worksheets, oral explanations, student-provided backup files, or printed representative works. Do not edit the same work in several tabs at once.
프로그램이 한 번 동작한 결과만으로 판단하지 않습니다. 학생이 고른 문제: Do not judge by a single successful run. Look together at the problem the student chose, the prediction before running, hands-on observation, before/after fixes, and explanations to decide the next support.
“무엇을 누르기 전에 어떤 결과를 예상했나요?”: “What result did you expect before you pressed it?”
“실제로 본 결과는 어느 기록에 있나요?”: “Which record shows the result you actually saw?”
“수정 전과 같은 행동으로 다시 검사했나요?”: “Did you re-check with the same action as before the fix?”
“이 방법을 다른 앱에 쓰려면 어떤 조건을 바꿔야 하나요?”: “To use this method in another app, which conditions would you change?”
프롬프트 길이·코드 줄 수·장식의 양으로 이해도를 평가하지 않습니다. 자: Do not assess understanding by prompt length, lines of code, or amount of decoration. Distinguish auto checks, student hands-on checks, friend/teacher feedback, and what is not checked yet.
□ 실제 저장 상태 □ 필요한 버전 이름 □ JSON 다운로드 파: □ Real save status   □ Needed version names   □ JSON download file   □ Next steps
학생에게 “잘 만들었다”만 말하기보다 “같은 정답을 다시 눌러 점수가 유: Rather than just “Nice work,” give feedback on the action you observed: “You pressed the same correct answer again to check the score stayed the same.”
수업 자료와 앱의 화면 이름은 2026년 10월 25일 배포판을 기준으로: Lesson materials and app screen names follow the October 25, 2026 release. If button names change later, look for the same flow: goal, request, prediction, check, explain.
Share an annoying moment and choose who the app is for.
만들기 약속의 예시를 고친 뒤 확인한다. 원문 한 문장을 쓰고 요청문을: Edit the sample promise and confirm it. Write one original sentence and tidy the request.
Write the prediction first, then press the correct and a wrong answer to observe the message and score.
안내 문장 한 가지를 고치고 같은 행동으로 다시 검사한다. 바꾼 이유를: Change one message and re-check with the same action. Write why you changed it.
Explain the changed message and reason to a partner and confirm save status.
Find what is missing from “Make me a fun quiz.”
Read the current request and check user, problem, input, result, edge cases, and done condition.
Make the promise specific, confirm it, and tidy the request again.
Compare sentences before and after; design two checks for the new conditions.
Read one added done condition aloud and save the request version.
Read only one choice's text and predict the next scene.
Find the choice (input), the link rule, and the current scene (remembered value).
Run both paths, return to start, and compare prediction with actual.
Change one choice text or scene description, then re-check both paths.
Tell a partner: choice → link rule → current scene → screen result.
Name the values the app must keep remembering even when the screen changes.
Find score, question number, and Already answered; solve questions and record.
다시 시작 전 예상을 적고 실제 값과 비교한 뒤 점수 초기화 규칙을 켠다: Write a prediction before restart, compare with actual values, then turn on the score-reset rule.
수정 후 다시 실행하여 점수·문제 번호·응답 상태가 모두 처음인지 확인한: Run again after the fix and confirm score, question number, and answered state all reset.
Explain the difference between the screen and remembered values; save a version.
Agree on what the score should be after pressing the same correct answer three times.
Press the first question's correct answer three times to reproduce and check the bug.
Save a before-fix version and change the scoring rule to once per question.
Repeat the three-press check, compare expected and actual, and record the reason.
Explain what the app must remember and save an after-fix version.
Confirm the difference and roles between basic practice and real AI building.
Students write the request and three checks. No personal information.
교사가 외부 도구에 요청하고 생성 코드를 검토한 뒤 별도 환경에서 실행한: The teacher sends the request to the external tool, reviews the generated code, and runs it in a separate environment.
학생이 실제 결과를 검사하고 수정 요청을 만든다. 교사는 가능한 범위에서: Students check the actual result and write a fix request. The teacher makes one fix where possible.
Record the tool used, help received, observed facts, and what was not run, separately.
Practice describing observed actions and confusing moments instead of judging.
운전자 가와 관찰자 나가 첫 사용을 한다. 관찰자는 다음 장면을 예상하고: Driver A and observer B use it first. The observer predicts the next scene and writes what they saw.
역할을 바꾸어 같은 작품을 사용한다. 친구·교사 의견 카드에 관찰을 기록: Swap roles and use the same work. Record observations on the friend/teacher feedback card.
Pick one piece of feedback, fix a message or link, and use the same path again.
Explain the feedback applied and the behavior kept, with reasons.
Confirm how the user, time, and message conditions differ from the example.
Set a new promise and request; write predictions and check items before running.
제한 시간을 20초로 바꾸고 종료 안내를 정한 뒤 시작·멈춤·재개·초기화: Change the limit to 20 s, set the end message, then check start, pause, resume, and reset.
새 과제의 결과와 원리를 설명한다. 대표 작품 포트폴리오와 8차시 활동지: Explain the new task's result and how it works. Organize the representative-work portfolio and the Lesson 8 worksheet.
Describe a check method to apply to other apps and confirm the backup.
Chooses a user and a pain point.
Links purpose, features, and done condition.
Adjusts conditions for a different user and explains.
Links rules to changes in remembered values.
Explains and applies state changes and edge cases.
Designs fix reasons and new checks from check evidence.
설명과 새 과제 적용: Explaining and applying to a new task
Explains help received and reasons for changes.
Transfers the method to new conditions and explains.
미션 대신 새 작품이 열림: A new work opens instead of the mission
미션 안내에서 이 미션 시작하기를 선택한다. 정상 새 작품과 학습용 오류: Choose Start this mission in the mission guide. Distinguish a normal new work from a practice-bug work.

자동 검사 통과인데 단계가 남음: Auto check passed but a step remains
Check the hands-on card's actual result, check status, and fix reason.
Ask whether the prediction was edited, then run the current settings again.

Was a setting changed, the work reopened, or a version restored? Confirm records are kept.
실행 조건과 기록 유무: Run conditions and whether records exist
편집 창을 유지하며 JSON 백업한다. 안내에 따라 파일 형식·크기·버전: Keep the edit window open and back up to JSON. Follow the notice to check file format, size, and version.
사전 예제나 인쇄 화면으로 같은 검사를 한다. 미실행을 성공으로 바꾸지: Run the same checks on the prepared example or printed screens. Never mark Not run as success.
새 생성·사전 예제·미실행: New generation · Prepared example · Not run

예상 한 문장·실제 한 가지·수정 이유를 먼저 남기고 다음 시간에 이어: Record one prediction, one actual result, and the fix reason first; continue next time.

교사용 안내서(14쪽)에 더해 읽는 자료 · 2026년 11월 2일 기준: Companion to the 14-page Teacher's Guide · Screens as of November 2, 2026
How to use the features added to the app after the Teacher's Guide was written. Keep the 8-lesson flow as is and add these where they fit. No sign-up is needed; everything is stored only in the browser on the student's device and leaves it only when files are exchanged.
칸 판 위에서 명령(방향·칸 수)을 차례로 실행해 칸을 칠합니다. 미션: Students run commands (direction · steps) in order on a grid to color cells. Four missions follow in sequence: ‘Commands move in order’ (sequence) → ‘Repeat it and you get stairs’ (repetition) → ‘Huh? The drawing comes out the other side!’ (practice bug) → ‘Follow step by step to finish the square’ (find the missing command).
먼저 예상하기: 명령을 읽고 어떤 모양이 나올지 활동지 칸에 미리 칠해: Predict first: have students read the commands and pre-color the shape they expect on the worksheet grid.
실행 화면의 ‘한 칸씩 그리기’ 버튼으로 한 걸음씩 따라가며 ‘지금 앱이: Use the ‘Draw one step’ button on the run screen to follow one step at a time and read ‘what the app remembers now’ (current position · colored cells · wrapped · stopped).
3번째 미션은 판 밖으로 나가면 반대편으로 넘어가는 학습용 오류가 들어: Mission 3 contains a practice bug: leaving the board wraps to the opposite side. In Settings, change ‘Board edge rule’ to ‘Stop at the edge (normal rule)’ and check again.
더 해 보기: 설정의 ‘조건 규칙’에서 ‘오른쪽으로 돌아서 계속 가기’를: Go further: under ‘Condition rule’ in Settings, choose ‘Turn right and keep going’ so the pen turns right when the next cell is blocked (board edge · already colored). Have students draw a border with one long command.
‘목표 모양을 점선으로 보기’를 켜면 점선 칸과 비교할 수 있습니다. 앱: Turn on ‘Show target as dotted’ to compare against the dotted cells. The app reports how many cells are missing and how many are extra.
같은 명령을 세 번 반복하면 왜 계단 모양이 될까요?: Why does repeating the same command three times make a staircase?
판 밖으로 나가는 순간 앱은 무엇을 확인해야 할까요?: What should the app check the moment it leaves the board?
명령 하나와 ‘막히면 오른쪽으로 돌기’ 조건만으로 테두리를 그릴 수 있는: Why can one command plus the ‘turn right when blocked’ condition draw a whole border?
화면 위 ‘안내 모드’에서 ‘쉬운 모드 (3~4학년)’를 고릅니다. 기록: Choose ‘Easy mode (grades 3–4)’ under ‘Guide mode’ at the top of the screen. Only the display changes; records stay the same.
낱말 블록: ‘누가 쓰나요? → 무엇을 만들까요? → 누르면 어떻게 되나: Word blocks: tap the ‘Who uses it? → What will we make? → What happens when pressed? → Rules to keep’ blocks to build the request text. Tap again to remove.
예상 문장 시작 블록: ‘이렇게 누르면 / 이렇게 될 것 같아요. / 왜: Prediction starter blocks: continue a prediction with ‘If I press this / I think this will happen. / Because’.
Read aloud: step guidance, mission text and the sentences students make are read with the device's voice. If the screen language is English, an English voice is used. If there is no sound, check the device volume and the browser's speech support.
기록량은 적어도 됩니다. 예상과 관찰은 말로 설명하게 하고 교사가 대표: Less writing is fine. Let students explain predictions and observations aloud, and have the teacher write down just one representative sentence.
서버나 학생 계정 없이 파일 두 개로 친구 검사를 합니다. 요청 파일에는: Peer checks use two files, with no server or student accounts. The request file contains only the app settings and check items, no other learning records.
작품을 다른 기기로 옮겨 원래 작품을 찾지 못하면, 결과를 붙일 작품을: If the work was moved to another device and the original cannot be found, a screen appears for choosing which work to attach the result to. Works from the same mission are listed first.
검사 기록은 작품당 100개까지입니다. 넘치면 필요 없는 기록을 정리한: Up to 100 check records per work. If the limit is exceeded, remove unneeded records and import again.
친구 의견은 앱이 정답을 판정한 것이 아닙니다. 기대한 결과와 실제 결과: A friend's comments are not the app's verdict. Have students also read the reasoning that compares expected and actual results.
학생은 5단계 ‘설명하고 저장’에서 과정 평가표 네 항목(문제와 요구사항: In step 5, ‘Explain and save’, students choose their own level on the four process rubric items (problem and requirements · understanding how it works · checking and fixing · explaining and applying to new tasks) and write ‘what to try next’.
포트폴리오의 ‘과정 평가 · 나와 선생님’ 표에서 자기 평가와 선생님 평: The portfolio's ‘Process assessment · me and my teacher’ table shows self-assessment and teacher assessment side by side. These are not scores computed by the app.
교사는 교사 자료실의 ‘학급 작품 모으기’ 탭에 학생 작품 파일을 모아: Teachers gather student work files in the ‘Collect class work’ tab of the Teacher Room, review the level table, and return assessments as a file.
평가하던 학급 목록은 같은 기기에서 새로고침하거나 다시 열어도 이어서 열: The class list being assessed stays open on the same device after a refresh or reopen. Use ‘Clear list’ when the lesson is over.
교사 자료실의 차시에서 ‘수업 진행 화면’을 엽니다. 프로젝터에 크게 띄: Open ‘Lesson presentation screen’ from a lesson in the Teacher Room. It is designed for a projector.
진행 단계: 도입 · 전개 · 정리와 오늘의 미션, 먼저 예상하기, 검사: Lesson stages: shows Intro · Activity · Wrap-up with today's mission, predict first, what to check, and closing questions in order.
활동 타이머: 시간을 정해 시작·멈춤합니다. 끝나면 ‘활동 시간이 끝났어: Activity timer: set a time and start/stop. When it ends, ‘Activity time is up.’ appears in large text.
짝 역할 교대: 10분마다 운전자(짝 A·짝 B)와 관찰자를 바꾸라고 알: Partner role swap: every 10 minutes it prompts swapping the driver (partner A · partner B) and observer.
소리 알림: ‘소리로도 알리기’를 켜면 교대 때 두 번, 종료 때 세 번: Sound alerts: with ‘Also alert with sound’ on, it chimes twice at a swap and three times at the end. Sound is prepared on the first ‘Start’, so check the classroom speaker volume beforehand.
전체 화면: 지원하는 브라우저에서는 ‘전체 화면’ 버튼이 나옵니다. 지원: Full screen: supported browsers show a ‘Full screen’ button. On unsupported devices (some tablets · phones), it explains how to enlarge via the browser menu instead.
작품 화면 위 ‘되돌리기’·‘다시 하기’ 버튼을 누릅니다. 글 입력 칸: Use the ‘Undo’ · ‘Redo’ buttons above the work screen. Outside text fields, Ctrl+Z · Ctrl+Shift+Z (or Ctrl+Y; ⌘ on Mac) also work. Inside a text field, the browser's own text undo runs first. Consecutive keystrokes are grouped into one step.
Saving, restoring and deleting versions, and deleting check records, can also be undone. Button presses on the run screen are not added to undo history.
Undo history keeps up to 50 steps per work, in the same browser tab only. It survives a refresh but is lost when the tab closes. Use ‘Save version’ for anything to keep long-term.
‘다음 사용자 시작’이나 ‘이 앱의 데이터 전체 삭제’를 하면 되돌리기: ‘Start next user’ or ‘Delete all app data’ also clears undo history.
화면 위 ‘언어 · Language’에서 English를 고르면 학생이: Choose English under ‘언어 · Language’ at the top of the screen. The entire student interface (home · first try · missions · the five work steps · settings · checks · action log · portfolio · work shelf · peer check · word blocks · error messages) and mission text switch to English.
교사 화면(차시 안내·학급 작품 모으기·수업 진행 화면·미션 만들기·작품: Teacher screens (lesson guides · Collect class work · Lesson presentation screen · Make a mission · Work showcase · lesson kit), finished examples and mission starter text also switch to English. Printable teacher materials (PDF · Word) and teacher-made missions stay in Korean. English worksheets for students are available separately.
학생이 쓴 글과 이미 저장한 버전 이름은 바뀌지 않습니다. 언어를 바꿔도: Student writing and saved version names do not change. Records stay the same when the language is switched.
기록은 학생 계정이 아니라 기기의 브라우저에 저장됩니다. 같은 기기를 쓰: Records are stored in the device's browser, not in a student account. The next person using the device can see them, so teach students not to enter personal information.
수업이 끝나면 작품 파일을 내려받아 보관한 뒤 ‘다음 사용자 시작’을 누: At the end of the lesson, download and keep the work files, then press ‘Start next user’. Previous records are collapsed in the list and do not carry over automatically (this is not privacy protection).
When returning or resetting a device, use ‘Delete all app data’. Data from other apps at the same address is not deleted.
작품 선반의 ‘수업 끝 정리 도우미’는 저장 확인 → 모든 작품 파일로: The ‘End-of-class wrap-up’ on the work shelf walks through: confirm saves → download all works as files → Start next user or delete all. The final button is enabled only after choosing back up or skip.
4단계에서 ‘현재 설정 자동 검사’를 눌러 실패한 검사가 있으면 ‘앱이: In step 4, press ‘Auto-check current settings’; if any check fails, ‘Problems the app found and tailored hints’ appears. Only the problem is shown at first; press ‘Show hint’ to reveal how to fix it.
힌트는 AI가 아니라 자동 검사와 같은 규칙으로 찾습니다. 예: 같은 정: Hints come from the same rules as auto-check, not AI. Examples: pressing the same correct answer repeatedly raises the score again → scoring rule; the target ending is unreachable → scene link map; a missing cell in a pattern → the command from the last position to the nearest missing cell.
학습용 오류를 스스로 찾게 하려면 자동 검사 전에 먼저 예상·관찰을 기록: To have students find practice bugs themselves, have them record predictions and observations before auto-check. Even after seeing a hint, they should record what happened when they pressed it themselves.
10. 앱 파일로 내보내기와 QR로 주고받기: 10. Export as app file and QR exchange
작품 화면과 포트폴리오의 ‘앱 파일로 내보내기’는 만든 앱을 HTML 파: ‘Export as app file’ on the work screen and portfolio saves the app as a single HTML file. It opens in a browser offline and contains only the work settings, no learning records.
‘QR로 보내기’(작품)와 ‘요청을 QR로 보내기’(친구 검사)는 큰 Q: ‘Send by QR’ (work) and ‘Send request by QR’ (peer check) display a large QR code. Point the receiving device's camera app at it to open the link, then press ‘Receive as new work’ or ‘Open in peer check’.
QR 주소의 # 뒤쪽에 담긴 내용은 서버로 보내지지 않습니다. 장면이 많: The content after # in the QR link is not sent to a server. Large works, such as stories with many scenes, do not fit in a QR code; tell students to send a file instead.
화면 위 ‘화면 보기’에서 ‘고대비 화면’을 켜면 글자·테두리는 검정,: Turn on ‘High contrast’ under ‘Display’ at the top of the screen: text and borders become black, the background white, and selected buttons fill black.
‘읽기 쉬운 글꼴 · 넓은 줄 간격’은 글자를 키우고 글자·낱말·줄 사이: ‘Readable font · wide spacing’ enlarges text and widens letter, word and line spacing. Recommend it for students with low vision or reading difficulties.
패턴 그리기의 목표 칸은 방향키로 옮기고 Enter나 스페이스로 넣고 뺄: In pattern drawing, target cells can be moved with arrow keys and toggled with Enter or Space.
12. 선생님 미션 만들기와 학급 진행 그래프: 12. Making teacher's missions and class progress graph
교사 자료실 ‘미션 만들기’에서 프로젝트 종류, 제목·목표·예상 질문·과: In ‘Make a mission’ in the Teacher Room, set the project type, title · goal · prediction question · task, starting settings (preview on the run screen), whether to include a practice bug, check items (1–6), hints (1–3), and closing questions.
‘이 기기에 미션 더하기’를 누르면 미션 공작대에 ‘선생님 미션’으로 나: Press ‘Add mission to this device’ and it appears in the Mission Workbench as a ‘teacher's mission’. Download it with ‘Download mission file’ and open it on student devices with ‘Import file’ to add it there too.
선생님 미션으로 만든 작품을 학급 작품 모으기로 받으려면 교사 기기에도: To receive works made from a teacher's mission in Collect class work, the teacher's device must have the same mission. Keep the mission file.
학급 작품 모으기의 ‘학급 진행 요약 그래프’는 다음에 기록할 단계별 학: The ‘Class progress summary’ in Collect class work shows how many students are at each next step, how many mission hints were opened, and the average gap between self- and teacher assessment. It gives a one-line note on the step where most students stopped and the item with the largest gap; ‘View as table’ shows the same data as a table.
다섯 번째 앱 종류입니다. 버튼을 누르면 앱이 기억하는 값(예: 스티커: The fifth app type. Pressing a button changes a value the app remembers (e.g. sticker count), and the message of the first matching condition from the top (at least · at most · equals) appears. If none match, the ‘otherwise’ message appears.
실행 화면 아래에 지금 맞는 조건이 표시되어 ‘조건은 위에서부터 차례로: The currently matching condition is shown below the run screen, so students see that ‘conditions are checked in order from the top’.
미션 4개: 5개를 모으면 축하(조건), 0 아래로는 안 돼요(가장 작은: 4 missions: Celebrate at 5 (condition); No going below 0 (smallest value); The top message never shows (practice bug: a broad condition hides a narrow one); Only when exact (equals vs. at least).
발문 예시: 6은 ‘3 이상’과 ‘6 이상’ 모두에 맞는데 왜 ‘좋아요’: Sample questions: 6 matches both ‘3 or more’ and ‘6 or more’, so why does only ‘Good’ appear? If you press +2, can you skip 10?
14. 버그 탐정 무한 연습 · 나의 미션 지도 · 성장 포트폴리오: 14. Endless bug detective · My mission map · Growth portfolio
미션 공작대의 ‘버그 탐정 무한 연습’은 정상 작품에 학습용 오류 하나를: ‘Endless bug detective’ in the Mission Workbench gives a new challenge: a working work with one hidden practice bug. It does not say where the bug is; once fixed, auto-check confirms it and the ‘bugs found and fixed’ count rises. Recommend it for students who finish missions early.
‘나의 미션 지도’는 미션을 종류별 길로 잇고 다섯 단계 기록을 마친 곳: ‘My mission map’ links missions into paths by type and marks where all five steps are recorded (✓), in progress (…), and not yet (○). There are no rankings or scores.
작품 선반의 ‘학기말 성장 포트폴리오’는 여러 작품의 예상·수정 이유·배: ‘End-of-term growth portfolio’ on the work shelf prints (saves as PDF) predictions, reasons for fixes, lessons learned and teacher comments from several works at once. It shows self-assessments from the first and last works side by side, useful for parent conferences and end-of-term assessment.
15. 작품 발표 화면 · 오늘 수업 키트 · 개인정보 확인: 15. Work showcase · Today's lesson kit · Personal information check
학급 작품 모으기의 ‘작품 발표 화면’은 모은 작품을 프로젝터에서 차례로: ‘Work showcase’ in Collect class work runs the collected works one by one on the projector, showing prediction vs. actual, reasons for fixes and how it works, one page each. Use arrow keys to move and Esc to exit. ‘Print praise & question cards’ prints cards for friends to fill in by hand.
교사 자료실 각 차시의 ‘수업 키트 한 장 인쇄’는 차시 목표·40분 진: ‘Print one-page lesson kit’ in each Teacher Room lesson puts the lesson goal, 40-minute sequence, mission QR, materials and things to watch for on one A4 sheet. Post the QR on the board and students open the mission directly with their device camera.

Detection is rule-based and can miss things, so keep reminding students not to enter personal information.
